entries.prompt:
Correct ONLY the two unsupported LOWER SIDE HOOKS in image1. Image1 is the current isolated Nightstorm mask candidate. Image2 is the actual small official masked Nightstorm photo; image3 is the unmasked biological head, proving that the ivory tusks and purple jaws do not belong to the mask.

The current isolated candidate invented two long gold pointed hooks hanging down from the left and right cheek rims to almost the bottom of the central ribbed gold strip. Those dangling pointed lower hooks are NOT sufficiently established by the source. REMOVE those two downward tapering hook ends completely. Retain the broad rigid cheek rails immediately alongside/below the narrow eye band, but terminate their lower outer boundaries much higher, close to that cheek/optical construction. Leave real transparent empty alpha beneath those short rigid cheek edges. Do not replace the removed hooks with teeth, tusks, fang ornaments, lower straps, a solid jaw or a closed chin. This is a deliberately PARTIAL VISIBLE RIGID MASK; the source-hidden lower side shell is unknown, not an invitation to complete it.

Keep image1's whole upper crown, EXACTLY two high flaring horns with their inward darker top tips, gold/silver oval frontal medallion, narrow recessed optical region, temple recesses, visible upper cheek rails and SMALL NARROW central gold ribbed nose/muzzle column. The central column must remain at its current observed short end, with fully empty alpha to either side and below it. Do not cut out or shorten that center strip. Keep source view, overall camera, horn/oval/eye proportions, gold-bronze and cool silver palette, restrained toy-like wear and every other existing surface unchanged. Do not add new decoration or reconstruct a rear/interior.

One isolated mask-only native transparent PNG. No wearer, dreadlocks, purple membrane, white/ivory biological teeth, flesh, neck, body or background. Center the retained complete visible rigid structure in the canvas with clear natural margins around upper horns and lower central strip. No crop, no fake checkerboard, no labels, no floor or halo. This is a localized subtractive correction, never a redesign or a new view.

REMOVE them all, rather than fusing, plating, recoloring or resculpting them into the mask. Remove ALL dreadlocks, hair bands, skin, neck, shoulders, body, armor, staff, weapons, backdrop, ruins, text and logos. Where these biological mandibles previously sat, the output must be genuinely EMPTY TRANSPARENT ALPHA. Do not put a solid closed chin, lower jaw shield, metal tusk or replacement ornament behind their removed positions.

KEEP ONLY THE SOURCE-ATTESTED RIGID MASK: the tall gold-bronze crown with exactly TWO high flaring horn-like side extensions and their short darker tips curving inward as shown; the large smooth silver/blue-grey oval/teardrop frontal medallion encircled in gold; the narrow dark recessed optical region with restrained grey-blue reflective highlights, not eyeballs or colored glow; the actually visible gold/silver cheek/temple rails; and the SMALL NARROW central gold nose/muzzle column with the few broad horizontal ribs that are actually visible between the organic mandibles. Keep that little central strip to its observed short end. Its incomplete/occluded lower boundary remains source-limited. Leave open alpha beside and beneath it; do not fabricate a complete full-face lower helmet. This is explicitly a PARTIAL VISIBLE RIGID MASK, not a complete invented shell.

Preserve source camera, width/height, asymmetries and relation of the two horns, oval and eye/cheek area; do not turn it into a side view, generic Predator helmet or artificially perfect new frontal sculpt. Source paint is weathered gold/bronze framing and silver/steel-blue-grey inset plates with dark recesses. The orange photographic background is NOT the mask color. Retain the gold and cool neutral silver distinction, no new lacquer, luminous eyes or saturated pigments. Small100–180px mask details do not support invented writing/runes, rows of screws, cracks, horns, spikes, teeth, filigree or extra vents. Use only restrained broad detail that is visible, gentle source-like toy paint wear, and soft photographic light.

One detached mask-only static PNG on true native transparent background, with generous8–12percent clear margin around every horn and the short central strip. Whole visible rigid shell centered, about76–80percent of the longest square canvas axis. No clipped tips, no ground shadow, floor, halo, rectangle, fake checkerboard, labels, frame, watermark, duplicate object, wearer or invented interior/back. All image creation/editing by ImageGen only, no CPU pixel operations.
